label: late original positions / <DEL> in long sequences, strongly boosted when the sequence starts with l
explanation: Timing is sharp: fires only at steps t=6..9 in the original phase or on the <DEL> step (t>=6 & phase<=1 covers 99.9% of activations and mass), mostly t=7-8 at the last 1-2 original tokens or <DEL>, almost entirely in L=8-9 sequences. Never fires in the copy phase or at t<5. Within that window it is sparse (~1.3% of eligible steps) and content-dependent: first original token l gives 13x lift and 56% of mass, and every top example starts with l (often with j/t/y early on and an a/i input near the end). Other first tokens (o, 2, 3) give weaker lift. Restricting to first_tok==l raises precision only to ~17% (dev F1 0.25, mass recall 0.56). Adding seen(j/t/y) gives a small gain (F1 0.29). The rest of the content dependence was not captured by simple predicates.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=l (+6.48), prev_tok=i (+4.36), orig2=j (+3.74), orig0=2 (+3.58), prev_tok=m (+3.13), orig0=o (+3.10). Lower it: phase=2 (-8.74), prev3_tok=- (-4.10), next_out=- (-3.56), t=4 (-3.44).
